Page.Name: page.custom.scrollspeed
Page.Title: Scroll speeds
Page.Subtitle: The same content at five speeds. Raven scrolls every widget at the speed of the system; here a widget with Class="scroll-speed-N" (and what it contains) scrolls at N percent: the window hook scales the wheel before the widget sees it (demos.c). The whole app also keeps each swipe on its main axis (rails), so a vertical swipe no longer drifts sideways.

Demo.Title: ScrollBox
Demo.Note: Put the pointer over a column and scroll the same amount in each: the numbers show how far each went.

Demo.Title: Other widgets
Demo.Note: The class works on anything that scrolls: a list at half speed, a code editor at triple speed.

Demo.Title: No bounce at the ends
Demo.Note: Raven stretches the content past an end and springs it back. Class="no-bounce" on a ScrollBox (src/scroll_contain.c) drops the wheel that pushes against an end it has reached: it simply stops.

Label.Text: Raven's default: stretches and springs back
